description: HTTPS Report: percentage of pages secure, mixed-content and insecure-link counts, homepage HTTPS-path status, and HTTP URLs in an HTTPS site's sitemap — for a project's latest completed crawl (or a named earlier one). Derives entirely from already-computed crawl data — no new work at read time. SOCKET-LEVEL TLS CHECKS STAY EXPLICITLY UNBUILT: expiring/expired certificate, old security protocol, incorrect certificate name, and subdomains without SNI/HSTS all need a real TLS handshake this fetch-based crawler does not make. `notDerivable` lists these with the reason. `homepageStatus.redirectsToHttps` is null (not measured), never assumed healthy, unless a standalone fetch actually observed a failure — this report cannot distinguish "checked and fine" from "never checked" from stored issue rows alone. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `no_audit` (no completed crawl yet), `analysed`. Free — charges no credits, makes no external call.

auditId.description: Audit ID, from crawl_site or get_crawl_results. Omitted means the latest completed audit for this project.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_audit_https_report
